finding: Migration Manifest Omission of Central Policies (Migration 033). Migration 033 exists on disk but is excluded from MIGRATION_MANIFEST in MigrationRunner.ts and packages/database/src/index.ts.
evidence: MIGRATION_MANIFEST array in packages/database/src/index.ts ends at 032_central_super_admin_features.sql; supabase/migrations/033_central_platform_policies_and_support.sql exists on disk with 130 lines.
rootCause: Phase 10 central platform policies migration was committed to supabase/migrations without registering entry in MIGRATION_MANIFEST in packages/database and MigrationRunner.
impact: Automated deployment and tenant onboarding runners will not apply Migration 033, leading to runtime failures on OTP rate limiting and support session creation.
recommendedCorrection: Add { version: "033", filename: "033_central_platform_policies_and_support.sql", target: MigrationTarget.CONTROL_PLANE, description: "Central platform policies..." } to MIGRATION_MANIFEST in both packages/database/src/index.ts and services/backend/src/infrastructure/database/MigrationRunner.ts.
dependencies: Super Admin, Auth rate-limiting, Support diagnostics
verificationMethod: Execute MigrationRunner test track and verify schema_migrations table records 033.

finding: Duplicate Migration Version 031 and Residual Quarantined File. File 031_remove_dairy_admin_7507495615.sql collides with 031_dairy_database_mappings.sql.
evidence: Two files with prefix 031 present in supabase/migrations directory.
rootCause: Targeted admin purge script was formatted as a migration instead of an ad-hoc administrative maintenance script.
impact: Sorting ambiguity in directory scanners; risk of unintended destructive execution if generic migration tools scan supabase/migrations.
recommendedCorrection: Move 031_remove_dairy_admin_7507495615.sql out of supabase/migrations into scripts/archive/ or scripts/maintenance/.
verificationMethod: Verify supabase/migrations has strictly unique monotonic integer prefixes.

uiField: Active Tenants, Total Registered Farmers, System Uptime, Dairy Registry Table
finding: Silent In-Memory Mock Fallback in Super Admin Client. Catch blocks silently return synthetic mock data without warning the operator.
evidence: apps/dfarm-super-admin/src/api/client.ts lines 170-182: try { ... } catch {} return mockBackend.getDashboardMetrics()
rootCause: Development test scaffolding was left as silent fallback in production apiClient methods.
impact: Super Administrator may believe platform metrics and dairy lists are live when they are actually reading local mock memory state.
recommendedCorrection: Remove silent catch fallbacks; re-throw network errors to display legitimate error banners with retry buttons.
verificationMethod: Stop backend and verify UI displays an explicit disconnected error state rather than synthetic numbers.

finding: Physical Database Connectivity Failure in Default Environment (ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:54322).
evidence: Live HTTP query to http://localhost:4000/health/ready returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable with checks.postgres: "FAILED".
rootCause: PostgreSQL instance on port 54322 is offline in the test host environment.
impact: Operational backend queries cannot reach central or tenant physical databases without starting the container or configuring live cluster credentials.
recommendedCorrection: Ensure Supabase/PostgreSQL daemon is started via scripts or docker compose before deploying to non-mock environments.
verificationMethod: Verify GET /health/ready returns 200 OK with checks.postgres: "OK".

finding: Default Sensor Mock Measurements in Collection App Hardware Context when disconnected.
evidence: defaultMeasurements in HardwareContext.tsx sets fat: 4.2, snf: 8.7, clrDensity: 29.5, weightLiters: 12.5.
rootCause: UI initialized with non-zero mock sensor values to aid visual styling without checking hardware online handshake.
impact: An operator could accidentally record test values as real milk intake if hardware disconnects and validation passes.
recommendedCorrection: Initialize default measurements with null/zero and disable Save Transaction button until live stable reading is received from Web Serial driver.
verificationMethod: Verify Save Transaction button is disabled when scale or analyzer is not actively transmitting data.

finding: Dual Mounting of Clean vs Legacy Route Handlers in backend app.ts.
evidence: cleanApiRouter mounted at /api/v1 (line 75), followed by individual legacy domain routers at /api/v1/customers, /api/v1/collections, etc. (lines 92-110).
rootCause: Clean architecture refactoring preserved legacy router fallbacks for backward compatibility.
impact: Potential route shadowing, double middleware execution, or confusion over which controller handles an endpoint.
recommendedCorrection: Consolidate all routes exclusively into presentation/routes/cleanApiRouter and decommission redundant module router mounts.
verificationMethod: Verify API endpoints resolve to unambiguous single controllers in test harness.

evidence: client.ts attaches headers["X-Dairy-Tenant-ID"] = dairyId and headers["x-dairy-id"] = dairyId from localStorage.
rootCause: Early prototyping used client headers before strict JWT-derived organizationId enforcement was finalized.
impact: Architectural confusion; server ignores header in favor of JWT claims, but presence of header implies client can switch tenants.
recommendedCorrection: Remove client header injection in favor of pure Authorization: Bearer <token> scoping.
verificationMethod: Verify API requests succeed with only Authorization header.

uiField: Milk Intake List, Passbook Transaction Rows
finding: Unbounded Historical Queries in Customer Mobile App.
evidence: useCollection calls apiClient.get("/collection/history") without mandatory limit or date window parameters in default query.
rootCause: Pagination parameters omitted in initial mobile hook implementation.
impact: Performance degradation and excessive mobile memory consumption for long-standing farmers with 1,000+ intake records.
recommendedCorrection: Add default page=1&pageSize=30 pagination and date range filter to mobile query hooks.
verificationMethod: Verify API request includes pagination parameters.

finding: Passive Polling Lag in Cross-App Customer Passbook Update.
evidence: Customer App uses standard React Query without WebSocket or Push notification triggers to invalidate collection cache immediately upon kiosk intake.
rootCause: Real-time WebSocket event streaming is not yet connected to the mobile React Native client.
impact: Farmer does not see new collection immediately unless they pull to refresh or navigate away and back.
recommendedCorrection: Implement FCM push notification or WebSocket cache invalidator on successful intake event dispatch.
verificationMethod: Verify mobile cache invalidation on collection intake.

finding: Vestigial Large Mock Server Files in Frontend src/api/ Directories.
evidence: mock-server.ts in dairy-admin is 83KB; mock-backend.ts in collection-app is 12KB.
rootCause: Mock implementations created for initial UI design were retained in src/api/ for unit test suites.
impact: Potential confusion for developers and risk of accidental import in production components.
recommendedCorrection: Relocate all mock backend files into src/test/fixtures/ or src/test/mocks/.
verificationMethod: Verify test imports resolve to new test fixtures path.
